cohort: Albertans aged five years and older who received at least one dose of an approved COVID-19 vaccine between December 14, 2020, and April 30, 2022.
finding: The study identified 72.0 reported AEFI per 100,000 vaccinated individuals in Alberta, with females, presence of comorbidities, days to symptom onset, vaccine type, and number of doses being significant factors associated with an AEFI event.
